import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_68/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_68/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join Source2_68_0 and Source2_68_1 on 'school_name'
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by 'school_name' and 'type' from Source2_68_0
# Aggregations:
# - sum of size as 'Total Students'
# - sum of budget as 'Total School Budget'
# - average of math_score as 'Average Math Score'
# - average of reading_score as 'Average Reading Score'

agg_df = df_joined.groupby(['school_name', 'type'], as_index=False).agg({
    'size': 'sum',
    'budget': 'sum',
    'math_score': 'mean',
    'reading_score': 'mean'
})

# Rename columns to match target schema
agg_df.rename(columns={
    'size': 'Total Students',
    'budget': 'Total School Budget',
    'math_score': 'Average Math Score',
    'reading_score': 'Average Reading Score'
}, inplace=True)

# Ensure correct data types as per target schema
agg_df['school_name'] = agg_df['school_name'].astype(str)
agg_df['type'] = agg_df['type'].astype(str)
agg_df['Total Students'] = agg_df['Total Students'].astype(int)
agg_df['Total School Budget'] = agg_df['Total School Budget'].astype(int)
agg_df['Average Math Score'] = agg_df['Average Math Score'].astype(float)
agg_df['Average Reading Score'] = agg_df['Average Reading Score'].astype(float)

# Assign to target table name
Target2_68 = agg_df

# Write the result to the specified path without the index
Target2_68.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_68/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_68/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_68/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name (inner join to keep only matching schools)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', on='school_name')

# Group by school_name only (the primary key)
# Aggregations:
# - type: take first (all rows for a school have same type)
# - size: sum as Total Students
# - budget: sum as Total School Budget
# - math_score: average as Average Math Score
# - reading_score: average as Average Reading Score

agg_df = joined.groupby('school_name').agg(
    type=('type', 'first'),
    Total_Students=('size', 'sum'),
    Total_School_Budget=('budget', 'sum'),
    Average_Math_Score=('math_score', 'mean'),
    Average_Reading_Score=('reading_score', 'mean')
).reset_index()

# Rename columns to match exactly target schema
agg_df.rename(columns={
    'Total_Students': 'Total Students',
    'Total_School_Budget': 'Total School Budget',
    'Average_Math_Score': 'Average Math Score',
    'Average_Reading_Score': 'Average Reading Score'
}, inplace=True)

# Write output
agg_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_68/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
